candidates.title: Broken Box Lid
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the community donation box could not close before a sudden storm before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they tied it with string, but the warped lid lifted in the wind; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized one hinge had loosened and could be tightened with a spare pin; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they repaired the hinge and carried the dry donations to the community hall, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Snow-Covered Lantern
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the safety lantern disappeared beneath a fresh blanket of snow before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they swept the path, but the next gust hid every familiar landmark; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a warm patch beneath a nearby stone showed where its flame had melted snow; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they dug out the lantern safely and marked the route with bright ribbons, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Hidden Book Chapter
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the old library book ended before its final chapter before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they checked the shelves, but the missing pages had no matching cover; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a penciled page number on a bookmark pointed to the repair desk; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they found the loose chapter and bound it into the book before the reading, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
